headline.purpose: h2: hero title and section heads, 20px/700.

caption.purpose: Muted meta, field labels, reader position, 14px tabular.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Single easing for press, sheet, toast, bars.

motion.name: reader-bars
motion.purpose: Reader top and bottom bars slide in and out.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce => animation: none; transition: none

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action, fill-grade blue with white text.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; background:var(--raised,#1F2229); border:1px solid var(--line,#2A2E37); border-radius:12px; padding:10px 16px; min-height:44px; font:600 15px/1.45 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Text','Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; color:var(--fg,#F2F3F5); cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s, transform .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#3D7BFF); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-primary { background:var(--accent-fill,#2A64E8); border-color:var(--accent-fill,#2A64E8); color:#fff; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" aria-label="Sinkronkan"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="22" height="22" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-3-6.7"/><path d="M21 4v5h-5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:44px; height:44px; padding:0; border-radius:50%; background:transparent; border:1px solid transparent; color:var(--fg,#F2F3F5); cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background:var(--raised,#1F2229); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#3D7BFF); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Search
components.description: Full-width title search with leading magnifier.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-3.5-3.5"/></svg><input placeholder="Cari judul"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { position:relative; display:block; color:var(--muted,#A3A8B3); } .ds-search svg { position:absolute; left:12px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); } .ds-search input { width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:10px 12px 10px 40px; background:var(--surface,#17191E); color:var(--fg,#F2F3F5); border:1px solid var(--line,#2A2E37); border-radius:12px; font:16px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Text','Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color:var(--muted,#A3A8B3); } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#3D7BFF); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Category Tabs
components.description: Pill tabs; the selected tab inverts to fg on bg.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:flex; gap:8px; } .ds-tab { border-radius:999px; min-height:44px; padding:6px 16px; background:var(--surface,#17191E); color:var(--fg,#F2F3F5); border:1px solid var(--line,#2A2E37); font:600 15px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Text','Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tab:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#3D7BFF); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-tab.ds-on { background:var(--fg,#F2F3F5); border-color:var(--fg,#F2F3F5); color:var(--bg,#0E0F12); }

components.name: Hero (Lanjut baca)
components.description: Continue-reading card with cover, meta, thin progress and primary action.
components.html:
Judul Seri

Batch 3, hal. 42
components.css: .ds-hero { display:flex; gap:16px; padding:16px; background:var(--surface,#17191E); border:1px solid var(--line,#2A2E37); border-radius:16px; color:var(--fg,#F2F3F5); font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Text','Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; } .ds-cover { width:104px; aspect-ratio:2/3; flex:none; border-radius:8px; background:var(--raised,#1F2229); } .ds-info { flex:1; min-width:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; } .ds-info h2 { margin:0; font-size:20px; line-height:1.2; letter-spacing:-.01em; } .ds-info p { margin:0; color:var(--muted,#A3A8B3); font-size:14px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-thin { height:4px; margin:8px 0 12px; background:var(--line,#2A2E37); border-radius:2px; overflow:hidden; } .ds-thin i { display:block; height:100%; background:var(--accent,#3D7BFF); border-radius:2px; } .ds-btn-p { margin-top:auto; align-self:flex-start; min-height:44px; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid var(--accent-fill,#2A64E8); border-radius:12px; background:var(--accent-fill,#2A64E8); color:#fff; font:600 15px inherit; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-p:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#3D7BFF); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Chapter Row
components.description: Series-page chapter row; current is accent, finished is muted, chips carry status.
components.css: .ds-chap { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:12px 4px; min-height:60px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#2A2E37); color:var(--fg,#F2F3F5); font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Text','Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; } .ds-n { width:32px; text-align:right; font-weight:600; color:var(--muted,#A3A8B3); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-t { flex:1; min-width:0; display:grid; } .ds-t small { color:var(--muted,#A3A8B3); font-size:13px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-chip { font-size:12px; color:var(--ok,#3DBE7A); white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Transfer Card
components.description: Honest transfer status: name, state line, thin progress.
components.css: .ds-xfer { display:grid; gap:8px; padding:14px; background:var(--surface,#17191E); border:1px solid var(--line,#2A2E37); border-radius:12px; color:var(--fg,#F2F3F5); font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Text','Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; } .ds-xt { display:grid; min-width:0; } .ds-xt strong { overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-xt small { color:var(--muted,#A3A8B3); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-thin { height:4px; background:var(--line,#2A2E37); border-radius:2px; overflow:hidden; } .ds-thin i { display:block; height:100%; background:var(--accent,#3D7BFF); border-radius:2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Reading-settings choice; selected segment fills with accent-fill.
components.css: .ds-segs { display:flex; gap:3px; padding:3px; background:var(--raised,#1F2229); border-radius:12px; } .ds-seg { flex:1; min-height:44px; padding:6px 8px; border:0; border-radius:9px; background:transparent; color:var(--fg,#F2F3F5); font:14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Text','Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-seg:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#3D7BFF); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-seg.ds-on { background:var(--accent-fill,#2A64E8); color:#fff; }

components.name: Floating Add Button
components.description: 56px blue circle, the only persistent floating control on the shelf.
components.html: <button class="ds-fab" aria-label="Tambah PDF"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="26" height="26" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-fab { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:56px; height:56px; padding:0; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent-fill,#2A64E8); border:1px solid var(--accent-fill,#2A64E8); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 8px 24px #0008; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-fab:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#3D7BFF); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
A comic-reader app for one owner, mostly on an iPhone at night. The page art is the brightest thing on screen; everything else is near-black, quiet, and one tap away. It is the category standard (a dark comic reader) executed cleanly, not a reinvention. Shinigami is the owner's reference for function and polish, not for look.

The system is deliberately small: three stacked dark surfaces, two text tones, one blue accent for actions and progress, system type, and one 1.75px line-icon family. Density is moderate and thumb-sized. There is no catalogue chrome, no ratings, no decoration.

Dark is the default. A light theme exists through [data-theme="light"]. The reader canvas stays pure black in dark and follows --bg in light.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground with three tonal steps (bg, surface, raised) and a hairline border. No decorative shadows.
One accent, split in two: text-safe accent and fill-safe accent-fill.
System font, tabular numerals wherever a number can change.
Every interactive target is at least 44px.
Line icons only (24px viewBox, drawn at 22px, stroke 1.75).
Reading progress is always a thin accent bar under a cover.

rules.name: The Two-Blues Rule
rules.body: accent is for strokes and text on the dark ground; accent-fill is for solid areas that hold white text. A solid accent block with white text is a contrast bug.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Blue marks action or progress, nothing else. Status uses green/coral, structure uses grays.

rules.name: The Inverted Tab Rule
rules.body: The selected tab flips to fg on bg rather than turning blue, so blue stays reserved for actions.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: .num, .muted, small, and the reader position use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, so page numbers, percentages, and transfer progress do not jitter.

rules.name: The Two-Line Rule
rules.body: Hero and shelf titles clamp at 2 lines; transfer names and reader titles truncate on one line with an ellipsis.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards, buttons, and rows have borders, never shadows. Shadow is reserved for elements that float over content.

dos: Do keep every touch target at 44px or more, including segments, tabs, and toggle rows.
Do use accent-fill behind white text and accent for strokes and text on dark.
Do build new surfaces from bg, surface, and raised separated by a 1px line border.
Do use tabular numerals for any figure that changes.
Do draw icons with icons.js (24px viewBox, 1.75 stroke, currentColor).
Do show real progress and status everywhere (percent, waiting reason), per the product principles.
Do honor safe-area insets on any fixed or sticky element.
donts: Don't use accent as a solid fill under white text.
Don't add catalogue chrome: ratings, rankings, recommendation rows, store-style cards.
Don't add decorative shadows, gradients, or glass beyond the sticky-bar blur.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or color a category.
Don't let controls cover the page in the reader. Bars hide on demand.
Don't use emoji or glyph icons in the UI.
Don't treat .impeccable/review/seed.html (synthetic review fixture) as product.
